title: Design Polynomial Using Linked List
problemStatement: A polynomial is represented as a linked list where each node contains: Coefficient Exponent The terms are stored in descending order of exponents. Process a sequence of operations on the polynomial: insert(coefficient, exponent) delete(exponent) evaluate(x) display() When inserting a term with an existing exponent, combine the coefficients. Print the result for every evaluate() and display() operation.
output: Print the result for every evaluate() and display() operation.
